Parent goal: goal-recursion-v2-execution-fabric; target Recursion v3/custom deterministic kernels. External Devin/SWE-2 construction work ON Recursion, never product-hosted agents. All input bytes are frozen at df158fe92fcdcb6fd7c05b040fcbf8b934ffcc58. Read the supplied authority/orientation files first. Tool-call budget is at most 64 broker calls; aim below 40. After the authority/orientation passages, use literal search and targeted read_file pages for the specified functions/sections rather than reading every supplied document in full. Respect the broker read_file page bound (4096 maximum). The offline source gate may hash all supplied bytes without spending one read_file call per page. Broker run_command is explicitly allowed for the stated Python gates; the prohibition on subprocess means gate code may not spawn child programs. No historical campaign gate or prerequisite chain is being resumed: these are new isolated finite test/prototype proposals against frozen bytes. This is a bounded source-only proposal, not renewal of any historical campaign. Do not modify frozen inputs, M1 contracts, scripts, control-plane/config/auth/provider policy; do not choose product language, store, framework, defaults, spending or autonomy. No network, subprocess, package install, live providers, workers, Git, publication, merge, deployment or arbitrary full campaign checks. Commands use Python 3 stdlib only in disposable offline workspaces, each <=60 seconds; bound loops explicitly. One worker attempt, no automatic retry, stop on missing source, source disagreement, unexpected dependency, tool failure, unclear authority or exceeded bound and report the blocker. Never fabricate observed results. A test failure can be a useful reported result but is not PASS. For writes use only broker write_file at exact allowed paths, with previous digest; command edits are disposable. Final response is exactly one raw JSON object with job_id, summary, findings, evidence, dissent, limitations, files. findings/evidence/dissent/limitations are arrays of strings; files MUST be []; broker collection retains proposed files. Evidence entries are only exact packet citation IDs or exact returned tool:N@sha256 strings, without annotations or invented placeholders. Put interpretation in findings. At least one actual run_command gate receipt is required. Keep findings <=8, summary <=1200 characters. All results remain accepted:false pending independent exact-byte review and rerun; self-reported PASS is not acceptance.

Extend test coverage of the existing fixed TEN-unit pool / two SIX-unit requests prototype with a small independent witness harness, without editing or copying its reducers. Import wr_domain, wr_inclusive and wr_split from their supplied frozen directory using sys.path. Propose only reservation_witness_tests.py. Use unittest and literal expected outcomes; do not use agreement between reducers as the only oracle. Execute fixed ordered paths from the supplied profiles and compare complete dataclass state fields between inclusive and flattened split representations after each edge. Scope is the existing central and rights designs; do not select a winner or generalize to arbitrary pools.
Required named tests: test_stale_read_cannot_admit_twelve; test_unknown_survives_restart_quota_wait; test_classification_does_not_settle; test_success_settlement_is_idempotent; test_nonexecution_releases_once; test_wrong_owner_and_changed_payload_refuse; test_duplicate_transfer_cannot_mint; test_stale_snapshot_cannot_restore_rights. Assert conservation sum(free)+in_flight+sum(reserved)+sum(consumed)==10 at each correct-model edge (in_flight=1 only for rights transfer state 1); also assert sum(reserved)+sum(consumed)<=10. Preserve the distinguishing availability of central vs rights; use source=1 transfer for rights when six are needed.
Add test_mutant_controls: the existing serialization, classification-release, settlement-idempotence and duplicate-credit mutant parameters must each produce its expected invariant/outcome violation under a concrete enabled witness. A surviving mutant is failure, never silence or weaker assertions. At most 500 transitions total, no exhaustive campaign run. Gate: python3 -B experiments/v3/external-20260914/reservation_witness_tests.py ; exits zero only after all nine tests pass and prints V3_RESERVATION_WITNESS_PASS. Report exact witness action sequences, mutant failure class and the finite-model/no-durability limits.

Test the frozen replay-store reader on concrete disposable synthetic namespaces, addressing the source dossier's unobserved nonregular-path boundary. Import reader.py and fixture.py via importlib from their supplied directory; do not execute experiment.py or spawn helpers. Propose replay_reader_tests.py. Build tiny TemporaryDirectory stores from fixture.artifacts/current/trust using ordinary writes; no fsync/power-loss claim. Observe uses the frozen reader. Each valid baseline must pass before its one-change negative control. Cover BOTH layouts (in-place/staged-generation) and BOTH cursor units (event/utf8-byte) in valid replay/gap cases.
Required unittest names: test_baseline_replay; test_baseline_gap; test_byte_cursor_inside_multibyte_refuses; test_wrong_generation_refuses; test_tampered_member_refuses; test_extra_member_refuses; test_duplicate_manifest_key_refuses; test_event_symlink_refuses; test_generation_directory_symlink_refuses; test_missing_snapshot_refuses; test_pointer_pin_mismatch_refuses; test_bool_cursor_refuses. Symlinks target only a sibling file/directory within TemporaryDirectory and are never followed to host data; in native Linux a skipped symlink test is incomplete. For shape/namespace controls recompute only the controller-held pointer/manifest digests necessary to reach the intended guard, retain each mutation explicitly, and assert the expected refusal reason instead of a generic non-success. Do not modify the trusted catalog to make a bad test pass. Bound at <=50 reader observations and 1 MiB total fixture bytes.
Gate: python3 -B experiments/v3/external-20260914/replay_reader_tests.py ; all 12 tests must pass with zero skips and print V3_REPLAY_READER_PASS. If the frozen reader accepts a prohibited case or throws an uncaught exception, retain the failing reproducer and report it; do not repair source or redefine the expectation. These tests establish namespace rejection on the command sandbox filesystem only, not Windows reparse behavior, concurrent snapshot atomicity or power-loss durability.

Implement an inert exact-arithmetic prototype for accepted OR-032: additional recovery allowance is a configured fraction of pre-shutdown task consumption, constrained by existing caps. It is a candidate calculation API only; it never dispatches recovery, reads live quota, modifies reservations, selects a default or supplies missing telemetry. Propose recovery_allowance.py and recovery_allowance_tests.py.
Use stdlib fractions.Fraction with explicit integer numerator/denominator inputs, excluding bool, floats, negative quantities, zero/negative denominators and percentages above 100%. Proposed API calculate(prior_num, prior_den, fraction_num, fraction_den, used_num, used_den, remaining_num, remaining_den) returns a dictionary of reduced fraction pairs for ceiling, remaining_recovery and admissible_extra; ceiling=prior*fraction, remaining_recovery=max(0,ceiling-used), admissible_extra=min(remaining_recovery,remaining_other_cap). Unknown input None returns {'status':'blocked','reason':'unknown-accounting'} without numerical outputs. Negative/malformed inputs raise ValueError. Units and allowance/window identity are caller premises, explicitly documented; do not sum or convert heterogeneous tokens/quota/money, and do not infer a quota reset identity. Arguments are cumulative across repeated recoveries, not a fresh budget per retry.
Required unit tests with literal expectations: prior=1/10, fraction=1/10 -> ceiling=1/100 of the same allowance (one percentage point); prior=100 tokens,fraction=1/10,used=3,other_cap=50 -> remaining/admissible=7; same with other_cap=5 -> admissible=5; second retry with used=7 -> remaining=3; used=11 -> remaining=0; fraction=0 -> zero; prior=0 -> zero; unknown prior -> blocked without numbers; bool/float/negative/zero denominator/fraction>1 -> ValueError; large integers beyond 2**53 remain exact. Add deterministic enumeration of <=1000 valid rational tuples to check monotonicity as used increases and hard-cap preservation. No timing/performance claim.
Gate: python3 -B experiments/v3/external-20260914/recovery_allowance_tests.py ; exits zero after >=10 named tests, prints V3_RECOVERY_ALLOWANCE_PASS. Keep this API explicitly a reviewable proposal; no M1 schema or canonical accounting integration is authorized.

Build a small literal known-answer M1B broker conformance test set using the frozen stdlib reference_oracle.replay_broker. This is supplemental regression, not full schema validation or live protocol support. Do not import schema.test.py or wire_domain.py because they require jsonschema; do not install packages. Propose broker_wire_tests.py only. Load F-M1B-020.json as the valid source fixture and deep-copy its input for independent literal traces; expected decisions are derived from M1B-WIRE-PROFILE, not copied from oracle output.
Required named unittest cases: test_literal_fixture_unchanged (full expected dictionary); test_event_cursor_contiguous; test_utf8_bytes_count_decoded_e_acute; test_ack_does_not_grant_credit; test_ack_cannot_advance; test_ack_cannot_go_back; test_gap_requires_immediate_reset; test_reset_requires_fresh_credit; test_gap_reset_fresh_credit_accepts; test_attach_cannot_launch_work; test_stale_epoch_refuses; test_cursor_unit_bound_at_zero. Assert exact status, relevant sorted reason set, final cursor and unchanged four semantic-work counters for each trace. Gap continuation refusal stays permanent even when RESET follows; ACK releases pending bytes but grants no new credit; utf8-byte cursors count decoded UTF-8 bytes. Include at least two positive recovery cases so blanket refusal cannot pass. Keep <=30 traces, <=15 messages each. If docs and oracle conflict report that exact trace as a blocker, retain failing tests and do not fix either frozen input.
Gate: python3 -B experiments/v3/external-20260914/broker_wire_tests.py ; all 12 tests pass and prints V3_BROKER_WIRE_PASS. In the filing distinguish a wire accepted-reset decision from actual snapshot installation, authenticated store evidence, process recovery and product Stop; none is proved here.

Produce a compact source-backed gap assessment for the accepted smallest deterministic aggregate + separately checked broker target (OR-036), focused on what the four sibling bounded proposals can and cannot establish. Do not depend on or assume sibling results. Use only the frozen supplied repository sources, not fresh web. No file proposals are authorized. Return at most six findings: (1) canonical authority/command admission, (2) reservations and uncertain effects, (3) replay namespace and installation, (4) wire credit/cursor boundary, (5) cumulative recovery allowance, (6) cross-boundary integration still unproved. For each finding name accepted requirement/source, existing concrete source support, an exact still-unproved proposition, and one falsifiable bounded next probe. Distinguish normative requirement from historical observation and candidate mechanism. Do not reopen OR-036/037, choose storage/language/provider, renew campaign deadlines, claim live status, or portray tools constructing the platform as agents running in it.
Mechanical evidence gate: through run_command execute a Python stdlib script that reads every supplied input as bytes, prints a sorted JSON array of {path,bytes,sha256}, asserts nonempty files and <=2*1024*1024 aggregate, then asserts exact substrings OR-032, OR-036, OR-037, OR-039 occur in DECISION-REGISTER, 'Exactly-once effect posture' occurs in STATE, 'replay-gap-continuation' occurs in M1B-WIRE-PROFILE, and 'not asserted as a filesystem power-loss guarantee' occurs in the supplied replay dossier. It prints V3_KERNEL_SOURCE_GATE_PASS only after all assertions. The digest report verifies source access, not correctness of findings. Cite actual packet source IDs and the exact gate tool receipt; independent source review must separately verify all six rows. Synthesize <=900 words total. Explicitly report no runtime, physical recovery or full formal-comparison acceptance.
Exact source gate command: python3 -B -c "import pathlib,json,hashlib; ps=['CONTROL_PLANE.md', 'ANCHOR.md', 'AGENTS.md', 'docs/v3/START-HERE.md', 'docs/v3/DECISION-REGISTER.md', 'docs/v3/ARCHITECTURE.md', 'docs/v3/STATE.md', 'docs/v3/M1B-WIRE-PROFILE.md', 'docs/v3/construction/shared-reservations-20260908/specification.md', 'docs/v3/construction/replay-store-evidence-20260907/dossier.md', 'docs/v3/ACCEPTANCE.md']; rows=[{'path':p,'bytes':len(pathlib.Path(p).read_bytes()),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()} for p in sorted(ps)]; assert all(r['bytes']>0 for r in rows); assert sum(r['bytes'] for r in rows)<=2097152; d=pathlib.Path('docs/v3/DECISION-REGISTER.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8'); assert all(x in d for x in ['OR-032','OR-036','OR-037','OR-039']); assert 'Exactly-once effect posture' in pathlib.Path('docs/v3/STATE.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8'); assert 'replay-gap-continuation' in pathlib.Path('docs/v3/M1B-WIRE-PROFILE.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8'); assert 'not asserted as a filesystem power-loss guarantee' in pathlib.Path('docs/v3/construction/replay-store-evidence-20260907/dossier.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8'); print(json.dumps(rows,sort_keys=True)); print('V3_KERNEL_SOURCE_GATE_PASS')"
